name: ANI Experimental Long-Term Climate-Analog Projection
method: Five nearest historical climate analogs within the same province, ecosystem, and calendar quarter. Distances use median-absolute-deviation scaling across rainfall, mean temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed.
validation_interpretation: The climate-analog method is less accurate than ANI's short-term previous-year seasonal baseline on the 2021-2025 check. It is therefore not presented as a replacement for the validated next-quarter XGBoost forecast. Its purpose is conditional long-term scenario exploration when future lagged agricultural inputs do not exist.
